messages:
maria_csm: Heads-up — Blackbird QBR set for Wed 3/27. I ran the cost signals this morning: embedding calls spiked ~3x last Thursday and daily token burn is trending up. Onboarding is partially complete (SSO still pending) so risk = elevated. Can finance/enablement/SEs join a 30m pre-brief today?

alex_ae: I can make a quick pre-brief at 11:30 PT. Renewal window opens in 8 weeks so want to flag any churn triggers. Who's got the route-level breakdown?

billing-bot: Alert — Projection update: forecasted invoice +62% MoM if current consumption continues. Top contributors: embeddings (56%), chat-concise (22%), rerank (11%).

jordan_se: FYI we pushed a change to their embed client last week that increased batch_size to 128. If their traffic pattern is bursty that can amplify token usage. Recommend temporary config revert + enable prefix KV caching. Example patch: 

```json
{"embedding.batch_size": 64, "cache.prefix_kv": true}
```

lauren_enablement: I'll pull a 1-pager playbook for the QBR — include SSO checklist, cost controls (throttles, batch sizing), and a short runbook for enabling prefix cache. I can demo the playbook during the pre-brief.

nina_finance: Can someone paste top 3 API keys/routes consuming tokens? Need per-key token/day for the last 14d. Also want to know if they use streaming or non-streaming generation heavily.

maria_csm: @nina_finance sending the export now — giving read-only view to the account's billing dashboard and the route breakdown. (upload: blackbird_burn_14d.csv)

alex_ae: Quick ask for enablement — is there a user-facing quota alert or in-app notice we can flip on to prevent surprise overage before the renewal? If yes we should enable it and coordinate comms.

lauren_enablement: We have a lightweight alert tile we can enable today: threshold + email + in-app banner. I'll turn it on at the account level for 50% of current baseline and craft the messaging.

jordan_se: I'll also open a small canary to revert batch sizing for a subset of API keys to measure impact. If revert drops tokens by ~30% we can propose it as an immediate mitigation in the QBR.

maria_csm: Plan = 1) pre-brief 11:30 PT today (invite sent), 2) enable warning tile + messaging (Lauren), 3) short canary revert (Jordan), 4) finance to confirm forecast numbers (Nina). I'll own the QBR slide that shows burn + controls + next steps. Anyone else? :thumbsup:
